origin: Charles H. Dow, late 1800s; codified by William Hamilton and Robert Rhea

tenets.name: The Averages Discount Everything
tenets.statement: Market prices fully reflect all available information, including known events and expectations. The market is a discounting mechanism.
tenets.implication: Do not fight market price action based on your own information; assume price already knows what you know.

tenets.name: The Market Has Three Trends
tenets.statement: Markets move in three simultaneous trends: primary (tide), secondary (wave), and minor (ripple).

primary.description: The dominant multi-year trend that defines the overall bull or bear market

secondary.description: Counter-move against the primary trend; corrections in a bull market, rallies in a bear market

minor.description: Day-to-day fluctuations within the secondary trend; noise relative to primary trend

tenets.name: Primary Trends Have Three Phases
tenets.statement: Bull and bear markets each unfold in three distinct phases driven by the behavior of different market participants.

bull_market_phases.name: Accumulation
bull_market_phases.characteristics: Prices are depressed; valuations low; pessimism widespread; smart money buys quietly

bull_market_phases.name: Public Participation
bull_market_phases.characteristics: Economic conditions improve; earnings rise; price uptrend accelerates; most trend-followers enter

bull_market_phases.name: Excess and Distribution
bull_market_phases.characteristics: Euphoria; high valuations; speculation; smart money distributes to the public

bear_market_phases.name: Distribution
bear_market_phases.characteristics: Prices are elevated; smart money sells quietly; optimism still widespread

bear_market_phases.name: Public Participation
bear_market_phases.characteristics: Deteriorating fundamentals; downtrend accelerates; panic begins; most trend-followers exit longs

bear_market_phases.name: Panic and Despair
bear_market_phases.characteristics: Capitulation; indiscriminate selling; all hope abandoned; selling climax

tenets.name: The Averages Must Confirm Each Other
tenets.statement: A valid bull or bear market signal requires confirmation between the Industrial and Transportation averages. A signal from one index alone is insufficient.
tenets.modern_application: Confirm signals across correlated assets, sectors, or related instruments; e.g., equity and credit, or SPX and NDX
tenets.non_confirmation_implication: Treat the signal as suspect; wait for both indices to confirm before acting with full position

tenets.name: Volume Must Confirm the Trend
tenets.statement: Volume should expand in the direction of the primary trend and contract on counter-trend moves.

rules.interpretation: trend is healthy; demand driving price
trend is weakening; lack of conviction
trend is healthy (downtrend); supply driving price
downtrend weakening; potential exhaustion of sellers

tenets.name: A Trend Is Assumed to Continue Until a Definite Reversal Occurs
tenets.statement: Once established, a trend is presumed to remain in force until clear evidence of reversal appears. The burden of proof lies with the reversal signal.
tenets.implication: Do not call reversals prematurely; require definitive structural evidence before switching bias
reversal_evidence_required: Break of primary trend swing high/low
Change of Character (CHOCH) on relevant timeframe
Volume confirmation of the reversal move
tenets.common_mistake: Exiting trend positions on secondary (counter-trend) corrections instead of primary reversals

agent_rules.condition: agent has external information suggesting price should be higher/lower
agent_rules.action: defer to current price action; do not trade against price on the basis of information alone
identify primary, secondary, and minor trends separately; base trade direction on primary trend; use secondary trends for entry timing
identify current phase (accumulation/participation/excess or distribution/participation/panic); adjust position sizing and aggression accordingly

agent_rules.condition: trade signal generated on one instrument
agent_rules.action: check correlated instrument for confirmation; if non-confirmation exists, reduce position size by 50% or wait for confirmation

agent_rules.condition: price in uptrend but volume declining on rallies
agent_rules.action: flag trend as weakening; tighten trailing stops; do not add to long positions

agent_rules.condition: price in uptrend and volume expanding on rallies
agent_rules.action: confirm trend health; maintain long bias; entries on pullbacks valid

agent_rules.condition: price pulls back within an established trend
agent_rules.action: treat as secondary correction; maintain primary trend bias; do not reverse position unless definitive reversal signals confirmed
require at minimum: structural break of trend + volume confirmation + secondary index confirmation before reclassifying trend
